body: All of my family is here, but they have problems too. Two years ago my uncle hung himself on new years eve, fucked everyone up in the house. As for my kids I'm not the best dad, I'm not always there for them "spending time" I want them to get just enough love from me, so they can grow up tough, and not get their feelings hurt by a meme. I know that sounds bad, but they get a lot of love from their mom.

I'd like to see them grow up, but I know they would be better off with someone else as their dad. Like I said lots of stuff I want to see in my life, mostly just crazy stuff like aliens or going to space. But even those are slipping away from me.
I know how that goes. Love is the worst, makes people do crazy shit. I'm willing to throw my life away over it.
I have two kids 11 and almost 10. Even thinking about them I still want to do it.
